pageProps.title: God's Quiz Season 4 (2014)
pageProps.review: With the return of Han Jin-woo from a coma, God's Quiz 4 strengthens the emotional and romantic elements while maintaining a balance between a message about the socially underprivileged and dramatic entertainment, leaving a lingering impression with a clean conclusion.
pageProps.content:
## Review Along with the return of Han Jin-woo from a coma, the dramatic emotions and romance lines are emphasized compared to previous seasons. However, it is still somewhat heavy.
It balances popular entertainment with messages about the socially underprivileged well.
It concluded as if there would be no next season.
